pr_title: Bypass MariaDB performance bug of the "IN" sub-query, fix incorrect IssueIndex
pr_comments: BTW we don't actually test against MariaDB, we should probably add it to the db tests (for another PR).

> BTW we don't actually test against MariaDB, we should probably add it to the db tests.

By this approach, no need to test it with any particular database, because it only uses simple "SELECT" and simple "DELETE", they are standard SQL.
Yeah, it's not directly related to this PR.

If you mean that we need to add a MariaDB for all test, I think it's not a must at the moment.

Although MariaDB is a hard-fork of MySQL, actually, they share the same syntax as MySQL 5.7 and the syntax is quite similar as MySQL 8.

As long as Gitea doesn't use any minority MySQL 8 feature, the current MySQL test is good enough.

Not really an expert in this topic, but I consider those two forks to have diverged enough by this point that they can not be considered the same database anymore. Of course if you limit yourself to simple standard SQL (and I hope xorm does), they should be compatible.

I am heavily using MySQL and MariaDB in my projects, AFAIK they are totally different databases now but the majority statements (syntax) are the same.

Maybe we can drop MySQL 5.7 support and involve MariaDB 10.x test in next release.

ps: XORM has already had some problems for various database versions (even for MySQL) nowadays, for example, the incorrect startup warnings, etc.

issue_context.title: Use join for the deleting issue actions query
issue_context.body:
### Description

Our current DELETE query for actions is rather inefficient on MariaDB:

```sql
DELETE FROM action WHERE comment_id IN (SELECT id FROM comment WHERE issue_id=?)
```

https://github.com/go-gitea/gitea/blob/ab388deb0e52c058a19dbd844bdd890f7cf84d51/models/activities/action.go#L688-L702

Caused by https://jira.mariadb.org/browse/MDEV-16289

see https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/issues/1161 and https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/1165



### Gitea Version

1.20.2

### Can you reproduce the bug on the Gitea demo site?

Yes

### Log Gist

_No response_

_No response_

_No response_

None
comments:
Thank you for the report.

The referred fix on codeberg seems not good enough (eg: the test doesn't cover other databases).

I proposed a new fix: Bypass MariaDB performance bug of the "IN" sub-query #26279


----

I didn't use "JOIN" because I think it's better to avoid using too many dialects for difference database, while pre-querying the IDs is fast enough.
~The main problem is `comment_id` in `action` table is not an index column.~
OK. I see, it's MariaDB's problem.
